marketEngineStorageCompatibility().details: Dispatcher verifies this marker on registration and before delegatecall; it only proves the module implements this selector with the expected constant, not that bytecode matches `MarketEngineState` storage.

positionKey(bytes32,uint64).details: Fixed-width `bytes32` + `uint64` packing is injective on pairs (no classic `encodePacked` ambiguity with dynamic types).
